1445-4871-5631-8250.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5631-8250.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2099-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
2099-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

3175-5147-8207.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

650-710-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1308-3129-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2292-3478-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

3240-5231-6351-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

465-4050-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4871-5497-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-6259.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

681-1669-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1669-6621-6664.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.

2988-4134-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2988-4134-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

2091-4558-4863-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least eleven tapped lands.
2091-4558-4863-6797.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Revolutionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Revolutionist by paying its mana cost.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Revolutionist.
Repeat.

1069-1256-5295-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-5295-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1329-2707-4872-6504.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
1329-2707-4872-6504.description:
If Conjurer's Bauble is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble. Then, cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Time Warp onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

1170-2397-3389-4826-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

719-1238-2351-4050-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

4186-4321-6010.notablePrerequisites:
Builder's Talent is at least level 2.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-4321-6010.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food token.
When the Food token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4013-4885-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1575-4231-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food, adding {C}{C}.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Repeat.

1636-3000-4170-4381.notablePrerequisites: Fain does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3000-4170-4381.description:
Activate Fain's second ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a creature you control, creating a Treasure artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure and Squirrel tokens, you may activate Fain's other abilities.

575-4674-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4674-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

711-2757-4067.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Fallowsage, targeting the basic land.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping the basic land.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Fallowsage.
Repeat.

515-539-2617.notablePrerequisites:
Squirrel Nest attached to Midnight Guard.
Midnight Guard does not have summoning sickness.
515-539-2617.description:
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

171-1367-2526-3247.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.
You control at least two Zombies.
171-1367-2526-3247.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege and Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger.
Resolve the Palace Siege trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Endless Ranks of the Dead trigger, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Razaketh by paying 2 life and sacrificing a Zombie token, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

678-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
678-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1532-2034-3255-3747-4477.description:
Activate Commander's Sphere's first ability by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Commander's Sphere's second ability by sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa and Child of Alara, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Child of Alara and Greenwarden of Murasa die, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, choosing not to exile it.
Resolve the Child of Alara trigger, destroying all nonland permanents.
Cast Faith's Reward by paying {3}{W}, returning all permanent cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield under your control.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, returning Faith's Reward from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
